## Purpose
Timeline-style card listing professional certifications. It receives an array of `SanitizedCertification` items and renders year, linked name, credential ID and issuing body, with skeleton rows while loading.

## Key concepts
- `CertificationCard` props: `certifications` (`SanitizedCertification[]`, from [[src-interfaces]]) and `loading`.
- Internal `ListItem` renders one timeline entry (dot, year, link, 'Credential ID', body).
- Shows two skeleton `ListItem`s while loading, via `skeleton()` from [[src-utils]].

## Gotchas
- The name is always wrapped in an `<a>` even if `link` is undefined, producing an anchor with no href.
- Does not hide itself when the list is empty; the parent must decide whether to render it.
